news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.03 (vs ₹0.13 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.03 (down from ₹0.13 in 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.01m (down 74% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 48 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 4 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 4 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Additional Whole Time Director Sandeep Gaur is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company’s lack of experienced directors is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Nyssa Corporation Limited Announces Chief Financial Officer Changes, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: Nyssa Corporation Limited approved the appointment of Arun Das as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) effective January 23, 2026. The Board also accepted the resignation of Mr. Prasanna Shirke from the post of Executive Director and CFO due to other commitments as well as non-availability due to other business assignments, effective January 23, 2026. Mr. Prasanna Shirke confirmed that there is no other material reason apart from what mentioned in his resignation letter. Mr. Arun Das is Commerce graduate with extensive experience in the banking sector, having worked with leading national and international banks. news.title: Nyssa Corporation Limited Announces Changes in Board of Directors Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: Nyssa Corporation Limited approved the appointment of Brinda Kar as Non-Independent Non-Executive Director, Vandana Singh as Independent Director, and Dhiraj Kumar Das as Independent Director. Brinda Kar holds a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering and has 6 years of industry experience along with 20 years of successful experience in running a self-owned plastic production factory. Vandana Singh is a graduate (B.A.), and has experience of more than 8 years in the field of Management and Administration and took active participation in co-ordination with other employees. Dhiraj Kumar Das is a graduate (B.Com.), and has ample knowledge of about 20 years in Accounting matters. news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.6% average weekly change). news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.01 loss per share (vs ₹0.32 profit in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹0.01 loss per share (down from ₹0.32 profit in 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹180.0k (down 102% from profit in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 56% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 13% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
